## 1. Summary

Kamruzzaman Polash (K. Polash / @pola5h) is a backend software engineer specializing in production Laravel and PHP systems, high-throughput REST APIs, multi-tenant SaaS architectures, omnichannel POS & e-commerce automation, MySQL performance tuning, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, and queued AI/LLM pipelines. He has shipped commercial systems for clients and engineering teams in France, the UK, the US, and Bangladesh since 2022.

- **Education:** B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering — International University of Business Agriculture and Technology (IUBAT)
- **Verified Certifications:** HackerRank Software Engineer, HackerRank SQL (Advanced)
- **Core Stack:** PHP 8.3/8.4, Laravel 11–13, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Laravel Horizon, Laravel Reverb, Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx, PHP-FPM, WooCommerce/Shopify APIs, OpenRouter/Gemini/OpenAI APIs, Pest/PHPUnit, Vue 3, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS.

## 2. Engineering Services (https://polash.link/services/)

1. **Multi-Tenant SaaS & Core Backend Architecture:** Schema/database-level tenant isolation, workspace routing, Spatie RBAC, domain-driven MVCS REST APIs, OpenAPI docs, Stripe/Paddle webhook billing, and automated Pest/PHPUnit test suites.
2. **Custom POS, Inventory Sync & E-Commerce Automation:** Multi-branch offline-capable POS systems, bi-directional WooCommerce & Shopify inventory synchronization using database row locks and central ledgers, Pathao/Steadfast/RedX/CarryBee courier automation, COD fraud scoring, bKash/SSLCommerz/Stripe payments, and WhatsApp Business Cloud API / Facebook CAPI pipelines.
3. **Systems Performance, Cloud & Legacy Rescue:** MySQL `EXPLAIN` query audits, composite indexing, N+1 elimination, Redis Horizon worker tuning, zero-downtime Docker & GitHub Actions CI/CD, and incremental refactoring of legacy PHP/Laravel codebases.
4. **Applied AI & Queued LLM Pipelines:** Production AI integrations using Laravel AI SDK, OpenRouter, Gemini, and OpenAI with multi-provider failover, response caching, prompt-injection hardening, and background queue execution.

### Engagement Terms
- **Structure:** Fixed-scope milestone phases or monthly engineering retainers (never unpredictable open-ended hourly billing).
- **IP Ownership:** Clients own 100% of source code, database migrations, Docker configs, and documentation from day one.
- **Response Time:** Inquiries answered within 4 hours on business days; scoped projects can start within 48–72 hours.

## 3. Notable Production Systems & Open Source

- **Vendzoo (https://vendzoo.com):** Omnichannel retail & commerce SaaS combining multi-branch POS, real-time Shopify/WooCommerce stock sync, automated courier booking, COD fraud scoring, and double-entry accounting.
- **Hishab:** Offline-first personal finance PWA + Android wrapper built with Vue 3, Laravel 13, IndexedDB sync, and zero-cost Gemini AI expense parsing running comfortably on 256MB RAM.
- **pola5h/laravel-flags (https://github.com/pola5h/laravel-flags):** Open-source Laravel Blade component package for 249 country flags and 210 language flags.

## 4. Published Technical Articles (26 Guides — https://polash.link/blog/)

1. **Laravel Middleware vs FormRequest vs Policy vs Resource: Layered API Security in Laravel 13** — https://polash.link/blog/laravel-middleware-form-request-policy-resource/ (2026-11-25)
   Covers the 5-layer Laravel 13 request lifecycle: `bootstrap/app.php` without `Kernel.php`, `ForceJsonResponse` & `SecurityHeaders`, `FormRequest` validation & RBAC `prohibited` rules, 404 vs 403 IDOR prevention with two-layer Policies, `DB::transaction()` file rollback/post-commit cleanup, `API Resource` allowlists, and PHP 8 `match (true)` centralized exceptions.

2. **CVE-2026-109618 (PHP2Shell RCE): How It Works & How to Fix It Today** — https://polash.link/blog/php-rce-cve-2026-109618-fix/ (2026-11-06)
   Plain-English breakdown of CVSS 9.2 unauthenticated PHP multipart parser RCE (`zend_bailout()` / `longjmp()`), safe patched versions (PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35), and exact Ubuntu, Docker, and cPanel patch commands.
